Passes when: Names the specific cause of the change, identified well enough that a reviewer could look it up: which customer, vendor, contract, hire or event, and what changed with it. Fails when the cause is a category ("timing", "growth", "higher volume"), even with an amount or dates attached, or when the only name given is where the cost was booked or who billed it.
Feedback when failed: Name the specific vendor, contract, hire, customer, or event that drove this movement.
Why it matters: A category can't be checked; a driver can
Example of good: Up $65K: Bluewater Health's one-time backfill ran on our Stratus Compute account (invoice SC-0731).
